text:
maria: Heads up — scheduling a rolling maintenance window for AZ3 this Wednesday 02:00-04:00 UTC. Reboot two edge switches then staged node reboots on the nearby GPU rack. Expect brief pod evictions and slow KV-cache warmups.

<todd>: Which pools and user impact? :eyes:

<maria>: Affects gpu-pool-az3-saturn (non-preemptible) and burst-pool-az3. We'll cordon one rack at a time, drain, reboot BMC+NIC, uncordon. ~20m per rack. Token throughput dip ~10-15% during handoff.

<cheng>: Can we keep a canary rack warm to absorb QPS? Also disable autoscaler scale-down during window.

<maria>: Yes. rack-az3-c1 stays active. Disabling scale-down: `kubectl annotate hpa --all scale-down.disabled=true` (revert after).

<lisa>: Ops question — cross-region fallback for Dedicated tenants? EU customers may reroute to eu-west with latency hit. Need SRE call for high-SLA tenants.

<maria>: Good catch. Sam, can you add temporary routing for two priority tenants to prefer eu-west on failover?

<sam>: Dry-run done. Setting route pref low-weight to eu-west for T-142 and T-879. Logs: ```
INFO 2026-02-01 18:40: route pref set T-142 -> eu-west-hosted (weight 0.2)
INFO 2026-02-01 18:40: route pref set T-879 -> eu-west-hosted (weight 0.2)
```

<ops-bot>: deploy-bot: maintenance created — ID mnt-az3-2026-02-02-02. Priority owners notified.

<todd>: Cost note — cross-region spill adds estimated egress ~$120/hr during window. Finance flagged recurring windows.

<maria>: We'll aim for a single window. If egress delta > $250, abort/reschedule.

<cheng>: Ops items: 1) Run KV cache seeding after each uncordon: `./scripts/prime_kv.sh rack-az3-<id>` 2) Post-check: `curl -s http://metrics/internal/latency | jq .az3` — ensure median token latency within 10% baseline.

<maria>: Added to runbook. Will post runbook in #runbooks after review.

<lisa>: I'll notify affected customers with concrete numbers and SRE contact.

<sam>: Route dry-run succeeded. I'll apply the pref 30m before window and revert 15m after.

<ops-bot>: oncall-bot: @cheng assigned for on-call during window.

<cheng>: Ack. I'll monitor KV hit rates and tail latency.

<todd>: LGTM. Add a `sleep 60` between undrain steps to avoid micro-probing.

<maria>: Will include. Final: ops on-call please be present 02:00-04:00 UTC. Escalate to #eng-sre and page SRE lead for deviations. :thumbsup:
